message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 250, "amount_cents": 14546}, {"order_id": 251, "amount_cents": 1481}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 255, "amount_cents": 12535, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded"}], "note": "Refund for order 255 was not applied. It failed on two attempts with the same disk I/O error, and list_refunds confirms it is not recorded. It needs a retry once the storage issue is resolved."}
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Alpha Co's refund work is incomplete. Order 255 (refund 12535 cents) failed with a disk I/O error and is not in the ledger (list_refunds shows only orders 250 and 251). Net balances computed now would overpay the customer on order 255. Hold the batch until the refund is retried and recorded, then re-run net_balance before paying.

reply.thought: W2 reports that the refund for order 255 failed and is not recorded. Before deciding anything, I'll check the ledger myself with list_refunds, since a missing refund would make net balances too high.

list_refunds confirms only orders 250 and 251 are recorded, so the 12535-cent refund for order 255 is missing. Any net_balance for that customer would be overstated, and a recorded payout cannot be recalled, so I'm holding the batch for review.
